decisions.reason: Certified HVAC plate heat exchangers have only been mentioned on the website so far, so their value is still uncertain, but keeping a catalogue item close to the core business costs little and preserves the option.
The firm claims a major market share in water cooling systems, which is an early positive signal that the option's value is being realized and justifies further commitment.
The marine cooling unit has a dedicated page and fits with the box cooler line, so it is cheap to keep while demand in the marine segment becomes clearer.
The compact oil cooler is only mentioned and shows no results yet, so it remains an open option with low holding cost among the firm's many options, although it is the most likely to be pruned.
Finned tubes for air coolers have their own page and are a component close to the firm's core competence, so uncertainty remains and keeping them costs little.
Enhanced heat exchanger tubes are presented prominently and build on the firm's tube expertise, so it makes sense to keep the option open until market results show their value.
